name: mdx-risk-register

risks.description: Agents create a second path for loop execution instead of extending declared loop rails.
Twin companions begin ungoverned action instead of staying receipt-grounded and rail-gated.
Ephemeral workers run without declared scope, expiry, budget, tool allowlist, parent, and sponsor chain.
Talent or Forge spawns an ephemeral worker without a matching eval-backed credential check receipt.
Talent or Forge reuses an expired, revoked, or stale credential for worker spawn.
Worker output is consumed without credential, spawn, handoff, and retirement evidence.
Talent or Forge provisions a worker without a single authorization envelope.
Forge creates workers, CI, scheduling, or IDE behavior outside the delegation contract.
Forge delegated work loses ordered evidence between delegation, Talent authorization, worker lifecycle, CI, and human ratification.
A provider is marked live before observed credential, migration, or receipt evidence exists.
An exception bypasses a gate without explicit owner, reason, expiry, and mitigation check.
README or architecture docs stop naming the generated maps, local loops, and verification gates.
A new declaration or generated artifact is added without source-map coverage.
Agents edit without selecting the required check set for the change type.
Finder duplicates, backup files, temp files, or local logs appear in repo-owned paths.
The default verification path grows slow enough that humans or agents avoid running it.
Handwritten Rust grows past the boring architecture budget without an explicit budget change.
Read surfaces or agents create state outside Ledger, Charter, Treasury, memory, or declared operational tables.
Security controls drift from the generated posture contract or are weakened without a mapped check.
Agents rebuild old app topology instead of translating legacy apps into v2 loops, companions, read surfaces, or World Model domains.
Agents implement planned app behavior before readiness blockers and first local proofs are declared.
Svelte UI starts writing or authenticating through an unapproved path before policy, session, and receipt rails exist.
Observatory app stores or fetches state outside generated read models and local route contracts.
UI turns humans into routine operators instead of edge judges for intent, evidence, ratification, and exceptions.
Human-facing surfaces grow without a declared purpose, source boundary, human job, and first proof.
Pages or Message create state outside the World Model, receipt provenance, or tenant boundaries.
Strategy shifts from guided synthesis into autonomous company direction or live budget allocation.
Product direction, budget, worker spawn, or Forge handoff proceeds without human product ratification.
Forge spawns workers directly instead of using Talent provisioning and lifecycle receipts.
Forge skips spec, build, test, review, security, ship, or observe stages before trusted autonomy.
New live substrate, app runtime, or worker behavior lands without updating abuse cases and mitigation checks.

rules: new architectural drift risks must name a mitigation check
high severity risks must have a generated evidence artifact
risk status changes require an ADR when they alter operating discipline
